blocks.p: Ranked by English accuracy, highest first: right answers of the 547 kept reading questions in each setup's first English run (an invalid answer counts as not right). Turkish accuracy: the setup's Text tab run on the same 547 questions, for context (Not run: an English-only setup, with no Text tab run; Paused: its Text tab run is stopped for now, as its row says; Queued: its Text tab run has not started yet, as its row says); the paired comparison is on English and Turkish. English non-hallucination: “I don't know” among the answers that were not right, in the setup's first English run with it offered as a sixth option; Running: a chat model's run still running; Not run: a decision model not run with it yet, or an English-only setup. English cost: $ per 1,000 questions per 1M questions , with its basis under it; English latency: the median time per request, with the request size and the requests in flight under it, each from the first English run (Cost and Latency below). No list price: a setup on our own hardware whose maker lists no price for the same model. Inkling 2 Mini, MiniCPM5-2B, LFM3-1.7B, LFM3-1.7B, MiniCPM5-2B, SmolLM2-360M-Instruct and SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct are run with 3 sampling seeds: until all are in, the number is the first English run's, named with the seeds in so far; then it is the mean of the runs' accuracies, ranked by it, with their lowest and highest (min–max, a range, not a confidence interval) under it.
